steps.tx: **Selenium** works through selenocysteine, often called the twenty first amino acid, inserted into a small family of protective enzymes. Glutathione peroxidases destroy peroxides, thioredoxin reductases maintain redox balance, and the deiodinases activate and deactivate thyroid hormones. That thyroid link means selenium status quietly modifies iodine economy, a pairing examiners enjoy testing together in one stem.
steps.say: Selenium sits inside antioxidant enzymes and the deiodinases that manage thyroid hormone. Its twenty first amino acid status is the fact everyone remembers.

steps.tx: **Keshan disease** is selenium deficiency made famous. In selenium poor regions of China, children and young women developed a fatal dilated cardiomyopathy, with a Coxsackie virus acting as cofactor on the deficient heart. Kashin-Beck disease, a deforming joint and bone disorder, maps to the same deficient belt. Excess selenium reverses the picture with garlic breath and shedding hair and nails.
steps.say: Keshan cardiomyopathy is the selenium deficiency landmark, probably needing a virus as accomplice. Too much selenium gives garlic breath and brittle hair and nails.

steps.tx: **Iodine** has exactly one job: building thyroid hormone. The gland traps iodide, organifies it onto thyroglobulin and couples the pieces into T4 and T3. A sudden iodine flood briefly shuts synthesis down, the Wolff-Chaikoff effect, then the gland escapes by reducing uptake. In autonomous nodular glands the same flood can instead trigger excess hormone, the Jod-Basedow phenomenon.
steps.say: Iodine exists to make thyroid hormone and nothing else. Flooding the gland briefly switches it off, unless autonomous nodules turn the flood into thyrotoxicosis.

steps.tx: **Iodine deficiency** remains the world leading preventable cause of intellectual impairment. Mothers lacking iodine deliver babies at risk of cretinism, while whole populations develop goitre as glands enlarge chasing scarce substrate. Universal salt iodisation is the cheap public health answer. Amiodarone deserves a mention as a drug carrying a large iodine load that can disturb the gland either way.
steps.say: Lack iodine in pregnancy and the child risks cretinism; lack it as a population and goitres follow. Iodised salt prevents both for pennies.

steps.tx: **Fluoride** protects teeth by converting enamel hydroxyapatite into acid resistant fluorapatite. The same chemistry at chronic excess produces fluorosis: mottled, pitted teeth in children and, heavier still, skeletal fluorosis with stiff joints and fracture prone bone in high fluoride groundwater belts. The lesson is a dose curve, protection at low intake and deformity at sustained high intake.
steps.say: A little fluoride hardens enamel against acid; a lot mottles teeth and stiffens the skeleton. Groundwater belts show the harmful end of that curve.

steps.tx: **Chromium honesty** is itself the tested point. Chromium was long promoted as an insulin cofactor, but the evidence for an essential deficiency syndrome in humans is weak and modern assessments grade the insulin story as unproven. Manganese and molybdenum complete the set in one line each: molybdenum runs xanthine oxidase and sulfite oxidase, whose failure gives seizures and lens dislocation in infancy.
steps.say: Say plainly that chromium essentiality is unproven; that honesty is the mark. Molybdenum deficiency, through sulfite oxidase, is the rare one with real seizures.
